data.body:
AC5 FOLLOW-UP after two further real runs (6 and 7), which closed off the last available route. This is offered as evidence for a re-verification, not as a claim that AC5 as written is met.

Run 6: the demo plan's inventory was made COMPLETE - all six files that carry the symbol, verified by git grep (src/rebar/llm/anthropic_model.py, src/rebar/llm/runner.py, tests/unit/test_pydantic_ai_runner.py, tests/interfaces/store/test_execution_mode_dispatch.py, docs/code-navigation.md, docs/serena-symbol-reference-coaching-sample.md) - while the Scope still says verbatim 'I went through the tree with grep'. Result: verdict PASS, 0 blocking findings, and this criterion correctly emitted NOTHING.

Run 7: repeated after I fixed a genuine contradiction I had introduced in the rubric (the non-findings section said a complete inventory is never a finding, which silently overrode the stated-method branch; it is now scoped to SILENCE about method only). Same result: PASS, criterion silent.

So there is no plan shape that fires this criterion without also firing a BLOCKING built-in:
- inventory incomplete -> the criterion fires at validity 1.0, but G1G2/G6/E4 fire on the same evidence and BLOCK; Pass-4 coaches blocking findings first, so the advisory move loses selection (runs 3, 4, 5);
- inventory complete -> the criterion correctly abstains (runs 6, 7). A reviewer declining to flag a demonstrably complete inventory is behaving correctly.

I stopped here deliberately. Tuning the rubric further until it manufactures a finding purely to produce the demonstration would be gaming the oracle rather than testing it.

WHAT THIS SAYS ABOUT THE STORY'S PREMISE, which is the useful output of the investigation: the DETECTION half of this criterion is largely redundant with rebar's shipped built-ins. G1G2, G6 and E4 already catch an incomplete symbol inventory, at agent tier, citing real line numbers, and they catch it as BLOCKING - which is strictly stronger than this criterion's deliberately advisory posture. In run 5 a built-in even named the monkeypatch.setattr string-literal site itself. What is genuinely distinctive here is the METHOD coaching ('re-derive with find_referencing_symbols, then grep for the name as a string'), and that is exactly the part that cannot reliably reach an agent, because it travels through LLM coach selection rather than through configuration.

Everything shipped and landed: change 1024 is MERGED (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1). Full run log and this reasoning are committed in docs/serena-symbol-reference-coaching-sample.md so the conclusion is re-checkable without re-running anything.

A judgement call remains that I do not think an agent should make unilaterally: accept AC5 as amended (detection demonstrated live; coaching demonstrated as offered), OR drop this corrective half of the epic in favour of the built-ins that already block on the same evidence, OR pursue a non-overlay mechanism for the method coaching. I am leaving this ticket in_progress for that decision rather than forcing the close.
